messages:
From: BlueCrest Assessors <audit@bluecrest-assessors.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:02:15 -0700
Subject: SIG intake - SDLC evidence request for BrightOak Capital

Hi Irene,

We're starting the SIG intake for BrightOak's upcoming due diligence and need a focused SDLC evidence bundle from Redwood covering code review, CI/CD controls, secrets management, and change management. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOD Tue 29 Aug? If there are items you cannot share, please note the reason (redaction, internal-only, alternative evidence).

Requested items:
- Code review policy and a sample of 3 merged PRs with review timestamps (including at least one with an approved security reviewer).
- CI pipeline configuration (YAML), one representative run log for a production build, and the guardrails (e.g., merge checks, signed commits).
- Secrets management docs: short runbook describing ephemeral credentials, KMS key rotation policy, and an example of a token rotation event.
- Change management: the change approval workflow, a recent change ticket with approvals (redact PII), and rollback/runbook for emergency patching.
- Any automated tests or linting gates that run as part of PR validation.

Format: compressed bundle or shared Drive folder, plus an index (PDF) that maps artifacts to SIG control IDs.

Point of contact on our side is Alex Mercer (alex.mercer@bluecrest-assessors.com). If you need to re-scope, flag apiece and we'll confirm.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Senior Assessor | BlueCrest Assessors

--

Team — forwarding BlueCrest's ask. We can provide most items but need to split responsibilities: Jordan, please assemble code review policy, sample PRs and the PR validation gates. Soojin, please pull CI pipeline YAML and one sanitized run log, plus the secrets runbook/KMS snapshot.

Notes / constraints:
- Do NOT include PII in tickets; redact user emails.
- For secrets rotation events, provide a sanitized timeline + evidence (audit log rows) rather than raw secrets.
- If any item is internal-only (e.g., full keystore backups), provide an attestation and the lightweight artifact instead.

Deliverable: a Drive folder + a one-page index (evidence_index_v1.pdf) mapping artifacts to SIG controls. I'll review before we hand to BlueCrest. Target: draft folder by Mon 27 Aug so we have time for review.

Irene
Irene Choi

Alex — thanks for the quick review. Answers inline:  
- SAST cadence: SAST runs on every PR as part of the PR validation stage (we block merge on SAST failures). We also run a full stage on merge for longer-running checks; evidence in the index notes both.  
- Vault audit retention: raw audit rows are retained for 365 days in the primary audit store. We can provide a redacted CSV snippet with event IDs showing lease revoke and new-issued token events — Soojin will attach a 3-row snippet (row IDs redacted) to the folder this afternoon.

We appreciate the timely review. If BlueCrest needs a short call to walk through the artifacts I can coordinate — Jordan and Soojin are available Mon/Tue next week afternoons.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
